title: Change keyboard layout OSD to show a list of all layouts, and the active layout's position in that list
line: Switching keyboard layouts now shows all your layouts in the OSD, with the active one highlighted.
explanation: KWin tells plasmashell only the name of the new layout, and the OSD showed just that one line, so with several layouts there was no way to see how many there are or which comes next. Now plasmashell asks KWin's existing org.kde.keyboard interface (asynchronously) for the layout list and the current index and the OSD shows all layout names in order, the active one with the usual list highlight and the others dimmed. With one layout or if KWin can't be asked, it falls back to the old single-line OSD.

commits.message:
shell/osd: list all keyboard layouts when switching layout

The keyboard layout OSD only showed the name of the new layout, so it
didn't tell how many layouts there are or which one the next switch will
pick. It now lists every layout and highlights the one that became active.

BUG: 506001
